candidate.annotationRationale:
The task targets mixed fraction addition and subtraction (cnm_p174). The written method works from left to right, uses same-denominator subtraction and addition (cnm_p080), and reduces two quarters to one half (cnm_p168). Reduction rests on cnm_p167; cnm_p165 supplies the underlying fraction meaning.
